text: The movement of trailers and semi-trailers is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Skhmeri-Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailers and semi-trailers is temporarily prohibited on the section of the national importance Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri highway km39-km60 (Nakerala Pass) and the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.
The information was released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia. According to them, the movement of other types of motor transport is free.
